source: craftax.craftax_env.make_craftax_env_from_name('Craftax-Pixels-v1') -- what the swm wrapper wraps; the wrapper layer itself is NOT exercised

pixel_equality.note: the wrapper jits env.step, so what a live workflow sees is the JITTED reference. This cell is certified against the UN-JITTED one, which disagrees with its own jitted self by up to 1.53e-05 in float32 -- enough to move a uint8 pixel wherever the picture is compressed towards one value. Any residual here is that.
